title: Alibai
tagline: Question a live AI suspect out loud, then call guilty or innocent.
description: A voice detective game. Each case has one suspect, played by an Agora Conversational AI agent with an Anam avatar, and three minutes to question them. The case truth stays locked on the server, and scoring comes from what the suspect actually says in the transcript.
author: digitallysavvy

media.thumbnailAlt: Alibai landing page from the live demo: the title Interrogate the Agent above two detectives at an interrogation table, with the Start Investigation button.
media.demoNote: Google sign-in and a microphone needed. English only.
